decisions.informationHealthSurface: Calidad/Salud de la información remains the residual human-action owner
decisions.sourcePreservation: Raw insurer source files remain in persistent Library; GitHub stores sanitized knowledge/rules/source references and QA evidence.

crossProjectCorpusReuse.rule: Reuse only same-risk evidence for quote/comparison; for insurer knowledge, quote samples may establish observed insurer/product facts without being reused as another client's proposal.

decisions.manualLoadPolicy: Notify Paula only when a source or business confirmation is actually required. Do not make Paula transcribe tables that can be extracted.
decisions.productCoveragePolicy: Knowledge program is multi-product, not Auto-only. Request sources just-in-time by insurer/product after current vehicle anchors are integrated.
decisions.noSilentDefault: No generic premium, issuance expense or installment surcharge may be applied when insurer/product/version authority is missing.
decisions.noAutoEnable: Stored or parsed knowledge never enables automatic quoting by itself.
